name: Yataka Chiho
source:
Hobbies: Collecting accessories
Liked food: Pizza

A fourth year at Harekita Academy, she’s always lively, but seems to have amnesia. For some reason, [url=/c34578]Souta[/url] is the only thing she remembers... supposedly, but Souta doesn’t remember her. 

Which would make sense, because __________________. 
Chiho shows up much more often outside of school than in it. Apparently, she’s out on a search for her memories.

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1089]MangaGamer[/url]]
